title: Kissed Canadian Salmon Broth
description: A tangy, aerated salmon broth with a splash of sake, smoky heat, and low-sodium flavors served in a Korean brass bowl for a Canadian twist.
instructions: Place salmon fillet in a heatproof Korean brass bowl.
Pour sake over salmon and let it rest for 3 minutes to infuse.
Add low-sodium soy sauce, smoked paprika, lemon zest, ginger, green onions, and water, then bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 8 minutes, ensuring salmon cooks through and broth collects flavors.
Carefully remove salmon and shred with two forks, then return shredded flesh to the broth.
Stir in chopped dill and simmer an additional 2 minutes for aromatics.
Remove the bowl from heat and let the broth sit for 2 minutes to aerate.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of sea salt if needed.
Serve hot in the Korean brass bowl, optionally garnished with extra dill.
